name: @zashiki/cli
description: A cockpit to oversee your Claude Code sessions. This CLI starts zashiki-server and opens the cockpit in your browser; a native desktop app is also available.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(require('./package.json').version==='0.0.0'){console.error('refuse to publish placeholder version 0.0.0 — publish is driven by the vX.Y.Z tag (release CI injects the real version).');process.exit(1)}"
